text:
I can't give you the current rate with confidence. I have no live data, and it's now October 2026, past my reliable knowledge.

The last level I'm confident of is a target range of 3.50-3.75%, set by the December 2025 cut and held at the January 2026 meeting. I'm not certain what the FOMC did at later meetings, including any after my cutoff, so treat that range as possibly stale.

To confirm, check the Fed's FOMC statements at federalreserve.gov or the effective federal funds rate (series EFFR) on FRED.
